title: centaurium chanetii
intro: Centaurium chanetii, commonly known as the lesser centaury, is a plant species belonging to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium chanetii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides (such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarin), which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities. These bioactive constituents also contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
